description: Puts things on the internet from Cargo: deploys web apps (Vite and other static frameworks) and serverless workers that answer HTTP requests, manages their deployments, env vars and secrets, runs a worker locally, and adds custom domains. Triggers: "build me a dashboard for this", "host this app", "give me a URL to share", "deploy this", "I need a webhook endpoint", "make it live", "promote to production", "ship a UI for my team", "give my worker an API token", "set a secret on the worker", "Missing CARGO_API_TOKEN", "my app cannot call my worker", "run the worker locally", "put it on my own domain", "make the site indexable by Google". Skip when: the app or worker should be declared as committed workspace code, use cargo-project.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent execute the browser workflow deterministically with explicit checkpoints?
Did the agent verify final browser state with concrete evidence?
